This test extract method with struct param.

-- flags --
-ignore_extra_diags

-- go.mod --
module mod.test/extract

go 1.18

-- basic.go --
package extract

import "fmt"

func _() {
    ms := MyStruct{sub: &SubStruct{}}

    Assign(&ms) //@codeaction("Assign", "refactor.extract.function", end=closeBracket, result=outer)
    fmt.Printf("%v", ms)//@loc(closeBracket, re`fmt.P.*`)

    fmt.Printf("%v", ms)
}

-- @outer/basic.go --
package extract

import "fmt"

func _() {
    ms := MyStruct{sub: &SubStruct{}}

    ms = newFunction(ms)//@loc(closeBracket, re`fmt.P.*`)

    fmt.Printf("%v", ms)
}

func newFunction(ms MyStruct) MyStruct {
	Assign(&ms) //@codeaction("Assign", "refactor.extract.function", end=closeBracket, result=outer)
	fmt.Printf("%v", ms)
	return ms
}

-- util.go --
package extract

type MyStruct struct {
    iVar    int
    fVar    float32
    subVar *SubStruct
}

type SubStruct struct {
    sVar int
}

func Assign(m *MyStruct) {
    m.subVar.sVar = 1
    m.iVar = 1
    m.fVar = 1.0
}
